event: COVID-19 closures: malls, restaurants (delivery only), gyms and cinemas shut
COVID-19 traffic-light system suspended (restrictions end)
US-Israeli strikes on Iran begin; Iranian strikes on Bahrain begin the same day
Strait of Hormuz closed to most shipping
Bahrain airspace closed (near-total shutdown of about 40 days)
Mina Salman Port struck by a missile
Bapco declares force majeure on group operations
Gulf Air relocates its aircraft to airports in Saudi Arabia
Alba (Bahrain Aluminium) facilities attacked
King Fahd Causeway briefly closed as a precaution (a few hours)
US-Iran ceasefire declared (strikes on Bahrain continued that day); Bahrain airspace reopens
US naval blockade of Iranian ports takes effect
Iranian attack on US Fifth Fleet headquarters in Bahrain (intercepted)
Iranian drone and missile attacks on US sites in Bahrain; debris damages homes in Manama
Islamabad memorandum of understanding signed (toll-free passage and end of US blockade agreed)
Strait of Hormuz partially reopened, traffic well below pre-war (IRGC declared it closed again on 2026-06-20, contested)
Memorandum declared over; hostilities resume
Iran declares the Strait of Hormuz closed until further notice (still closed as of 2026-10-11)
Iranian attacks set fire to Fifth Fleet fuel tanks and destroy radars in Bahrain
Iran says it attacked US assets and bases in Bahrain and Kuwait
